caption_mapping.1: Figure 1. Cohort construction and fixed-threshold evaluation. (A) BUS-BRA patients are split into development and internal testing; the development cohort selects each review cutoff at a 20% target. (B) BrEaST contributes 252 patients after exclusion of four normal cases without a primary lesion mask. Each analysis patient contributes one image. Development cutoffs are transferred unchanged to the 1,103 internal and external test patients. Low-quality masks have initial-prediction Dice below 0.70 against the released reference. Counts refer to patients and their single initial masks.
caption_mapping.2: Figure 2. Reference-informed prompting, observed SAM outputs and separate review scores. (A) The released image and reference from BrEaST case001 [10] define the initial box after 10% expansion per side. Actual archived initial, left-, right-, up- and down-prompt masks are shown in their full image field; white is foreground. Shifts are 5% of the clipped initial width or height. (B) Frozen SAM ViT-B encodes each image once and uses the shared embedding for five single-mask predictions. (C) Method A is one minus initial-mask predicted IoU; method B is one minus the mean initial-to-shifted mask Dice. Each score is evaluated separately against its locked development cutoff. The reference-derived prompt represents known-location evaluation. The workflow is a conventional vector schematic and the image/masks are measured study data, not synthesized illustrations.
